question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The quarantine period for travellers by road into this State has been________ to 28 days.
solution:
The correct answer is **'increased'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us see the meaning of the given words - 
 
 
• **advanced - **move forwards in a purposeful way. (आगे बढ़ा हुआ)
 
• **increased - **become or make greater in size, amount, or degree. (बढ गय़े)
 
• **expanded - **become or make larger or more extensive. (विस्तार)
 
• **enlarged - **make or become larger or more extensive. (बढ़े)
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would denote the increase in the number of days of the quarantine period. 
 
• Thus, based on the above meanings we can say that **increased **is the best-fit word for the given blank.
